---
format:
  typst: default
---

```{=typst}
#let navy = rgb("#1E2B55")
#let charcoal = rgb("#20262D")
#let slate = rgb("#596673")
#let mist = rgb("#D9DEE2")
#let sail = rgb("#F4F5F6")
#let pcss-gold = rgb("#F4C91D")

#set page(
  paper: "us-letter",
  flipped: true,
  margin: (top: 0.30in, bottom: 0.46in, x: 0.38in),
  footer: context [
    #set text(font: "Source Sans 3", size: 6.5pt, fill: slate, hyphenate: false)
    #grid(
      columns: (1fr, auto),
      column-gutter: 12pt,
      [#link("https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/")[#text(fill: navy)[CC BY 4.0]] - share and adapt with attribution to Andrew Andrade: #link("https://github.com/mrandrewandrade")[#text(fill: navy)[https://github.com/mrandrewandrade]]],
      [Page #counter(page).display("1 of 1", both: true)]
    )
  ]
)

#set text(font: "Source Sans 3", size: 8.5pt, fill: charcoal, hyphenate: false)
#set par(leading: 0.48em, justify: false)

#let blank-field(label) = [
  #text(weight: "bold")[#label:]
  #h(4pt)
  #line(length: 1.55in, stroke: 0.5pt + slate)
]

#let page-header(section) = [
  #grid(
    columns: (1fr, auto),
    align: horizon,
    [
      #text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Combined Teacher Marking]
      #v(1pt)
      #text(size: 8.8pt, fill: slate)[0.1 Past, Present & Becoming + 0.2 The Way We Meet - #section]
    ],
    [#text(size: 7.8pt, weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Technology Commons · Port Credit Secondary School]]
  )
  #v(3pt)
  #line(length: 0.58in, stroke: 3pt + pcss-gold)
  #v(2pt)
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + navy)
  #v(4pt)
  #grid(
    columns: (0.8fr, 0.8fr, 1.15fr, 1.55fr),
    column-gutter: 10pt,
    [#blank-field("Class")],
    [#blank-field("Date")],
    [#blank-field("Teacher")],
    [#blank-field("Expectation(s)")],
  )
  #v(4pt)
  #block(
    width: 100%,
    fill: sail,
    stroke: (left: 3pt + pcss-gold),
    inset: (left: 8pt, right: 8pt, top: 4pt, bottom: 4pt),
  )[
    #text(size: 7.05pt)[
      #text(weight: "bold")[0.1 Presentation:] IC Ideas/Content · OC Organization/Clarity · C Communication · CR Connection/Reflection. Record Levels 4-1 or BL1 as evidence, then determine P /10 from the overall pattern using professional judgement. Do not average the four columns mechanically.
      #h(5pt)
      #text(weight: "bold")[0.2 Listening flags:] PH phone · TK talking/side conversation · OF off-task/not facing · NN not taking notes · PR prompted/reminded. These are separate from the 0.1 curricular mark. Fill L /10 only from the separate 0.2 task. #text(weight: "bold")[LS:] R O IW C I SR.
      #linebreak()
      #text(weight: "bold")[Feedback:] use the final note for Strength + specific Evidence + one useful Next Step.
    ]
  ]
  #v(5pt)
]

#let table-header = table.header(
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Student]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[IC]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[OC]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[C]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[CR]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[P /10]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[PH]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[TK]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[OF]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[NN]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[PR]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[L /10]]],
  [#align(center)[#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[LS]]],
  [#text(weight: "bold", fill: navy)[Strength / Evidence / Next Step]],
)

#let mark-table(start, end) = table(
  columns: (1.20in, 0.46in, 0.46in, 0.42in, 0.46in, 0.54in, 0.42in, 0.42in, 0.42in, 0.46in, 0.46in, 0.52in, 0.62in, 3.05in),
  inset: (x: 3.3pt, y: 5.3pt),
  stroke: 0.55pt + mist,
  align: left + top,
  table-header,
  ..range(start, end + 1).map(n => (
    [#n], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [], [],
  )).flatten()
)

#page-header([Side 1 - Students 1-17])
#mark-table(1, 17)

#pagebreak()
#page-header([Side 2 - Students 18-34])
#mark-table(18, 34)
```
